description: ATKIS Schleuse (Fläche) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by fbinter.stadt-berlin.de. An installation for the transfer of watercraft between waters of different water level heights, including the operating area and buildings. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "ATKIS lock (area)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include dlm, Digitales Landschaftsmodell, DLM, open data, Basis-DLM, Schleuse. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2024-04-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
